question: Can public deposited mature-miRNA measurements and specimen identifiers be recovered for the 16 FFPE EMC profiles in MSTS2013 paper30, enabling evaluation of the existing fixed DLK1-DIO3 small-RNA question?
source: Extraskeletal Myxoid Chondrosarcoma: Micro-RNA Analysis and Pathogenesis; SessionIII Paper30,2013-10-04 at14:21. Authors Chandhanarat Chandhanayingyong, Rapin Phimolsarnti, Apichat Asavamongkolkul, Thomas R. Hickernell, Li Song, Fabrizio/printed Frabizio Remotti, Murty Vundavalli, Francis Y. Lee.
known_scope: Original program abstract recovered from a public mirror by functional reviewer; official routes fail.16FFPE miRNA profiles,20clinicalcases; qualitative namedmiRNA findings but no numerical miRNA values/sampleIDs/accessions. Micro owner independently handles later-publication/cohort overlap.
assignment: Trace public GEO/SRA/BioProject/ArrayExpress/BioStudies and explicit deposition links or author-associated accessions; authenticate candidate cohort/assay/specimens. Do not duplicate original-abstract retrieval or general publication trail. No invented accessions or private paths. Save exact tested searches/URLs and every eligible observation/status.
pilot_rule: Do not inspect new relevant miRNA values before micro owner has frozen a data-specific plan and annotation. If suitable source found, report metadata/measurement units/conditions and retain a bounded source with hashes. Do not claim that search failure proves no data exist.
stop: Bounded repository/linked accession trace; no broader disease substitutions. If source unavailable or unsuitable, state what cannot be tested. No new disease claim from an inventory.
restrictions: Read current AGENTS/OPERATING_PROTOCOL; full public EMC coverage and automatic scientific follow-through. Daily America/New_York06:00-10:00 no UI/browser/headless/screenshots; check time before action; Sept12 exception expired; quiet file/API work allowed. Supported browser unavailable. Reuse dependencies, no runtime/fullcheckout. No paid resources/outreach/external writes/publication/PR/commit/push. Previous DLK1 and other packets frozen.
